question:
Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. No one has the exam before V. Only four people have exams between P and R. Q has the exam immediately before R. T has the exam before U but after S.

How many people have exams between S and R?
solution:
Given: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) No one has the exam before V.

2) Only four people have exams between P and R.

3) Q has the exam immediately before R.

Hence, the correct answer is **Three** (Option 3).
